title: The scattered archive

stages.text: Find Tamar. Her scriptorium has the gold door, just north of here.
Walk into the tall reeds east along the path and capture the word hiding there.
Go back to Tamar's scriptorium. She has one more lesson for you.
Capture three words in the reeds. Tamar says the stream crossing will test you after that.
Answer Neri's challenge on the bridge north of the path.
Read the riddle stone, then choose the right door in the Field Gate.
Enter the Hall of Letters and take Ilana's trial for the Reed Seal.
Carry the Reed Seal to the arch at the north end of the grove.

reward: The road to the Vowel Springs unseals.

title: The pools that sing

stages.text: Find Tamar at the first spring. She'll show you how to read the marks around each letter.
Capture a word by the water. Now its vowels matter too.
Return to Tamar for the shewa, the maqqef, the dagesh and the article.
Tamar has one last lesson here: letters that won't double.
Capture six words around the springs.
Answer Neri's challenge at the water's edge.
Read the spring stone and open the right door.
Take the trial for the Spring Seal.
Carry the Spring Seal to the road toward town.

reward: The road to Nominal Town unseals.

title: The town of signboards

stages.text: Find Tamar in the market. She'll explain gender and number.
Capture a word among the stalls.
Learn the town's grammar: sentences without verbs, the waw, noun patterns, מִן and adjectives.
Capture six words around the town.
Neri is waiting at the square with a challenge.
Read the town gate's sign and open the right door.
Take the trial for the Signboard Seal.
Carry the Signboard Seal to the pass.

reward: The pass to the Perfect Gate opens.

title: The gate and the bridges

stages.text: The first verbs are carved on the gate. Ask Tamar to read the perfect with you.
Capture a word near the gate.
Learn to mark an object, then pronouns and demonstratives.
Only now can you cross the rope bridges: learn the construct.
Capture six words along the pass.
Neri blocks the first bridge.
Read the bridgehead's question and pick the right door.
Take the trial for the Bridge Seal.
Carry the Bridge Seal across to the workshop road.

reward: The road to the Suffix Workshop opens.

title: The owners' workshop

stages.text: Find Tamar at the bench, fitting endings to prepositions.
Capture a word in the yard.
Learn there is and there is not, verbs ending in alef, the relative, and suffixes on nouns.
Capture six words around the workshop.
Neri wants to see your work.
Pick the right door at the workshop lock.
Take the trial for the Brass Seal.
Carry the Brass Seal up the hill.

reward: The hill path to the Verb Observatory opens.

title: The turning rings

stages.text: Climb to Tamar's first ring: the participle.
Capture a word on the hill.
Turn the next rings: the imperfect, then the narrative form, then state verbs and questions.
Commands, then the waw that interrupts a story.
Finish the set: infinitives, verbal suffixes, numbers.
Capture six words around the observatory.
Neri is waiting on the top ring.
Read the observatory door's question.
Take the trial for the Ring Seal.
Carry the Ring Seal up to the high road.

reward: The high road into the Stem Highlands opens.

title: One root, many stems

stages.text: Tamar is at the first terrace: the Niphal.
Capture a word on the terrace.
Climb on through the Piel and Pual, the Hithpael, the Hiphil and Hophal.
Stop at the cairn and practice parsing, step by step.
Take the weak paths: gutturals, missing nun, missing yod, final he, hollow verbs.
Capture six words across the highlands.
Neri waits at the pass.
Answer the pass door.
Take the trial for the Summit Seal.
Carry the Summit Seal down to the ruins.

reward: The way down to the Narrative Ruins opens.

title: The first page

stages.text: Tamar is in the ruins, with a torn page. Learn to read whole clauses.
Capture a word among the stones.
Learn to follow chains and pauses across verses.
Open the first page with Tamar: Genesis 1:1-5.
Capture four words from the page.
Neri has followed you here, with one last set of questions.
Open the ruin's three doors.
Read Genesis 1:1-5 in the reading room, verse by verse.
Take the final trial for the Archive Seal.
Carry the Archive Seal to the rebuilt roof.

reward: The archive is restored. The Review Garden opens.
